create_app_subclass: create a subclass of App to build a custom application in the simulation environment
get_tools: retrieve the list of agent tools from an App instance by calling get_tools
set_failure_probability: set a failure probability on an App so tool calls can fail randomly during testing
register_event_callback: register an event callback function to an App using register_to_env for event handling
get_base_method_doc: retrieve the docstring of a method from its base class using get_base_method_doc
